answers.goal: I want to educate and help young learners build their creative and critical thinking. I'm interested in directing my work towards kids because they are at a point where the media they consume is instrumental to their development and future. I want to develop something related to play and learning, reaching each child in the way they learn best.
answers.drew: I think there is such beauty in the universal language of visual storytelling and helping people connect across different ages, backgrounds, and life paths. I am especially interested in how new tech can transform the entertainment industry and make entertainment more tactile and personalized. I am passionate about education and learning through play, through years of working with kids, and want to connect that with my art and design background.
answers.seeking: I want to feel like the least creative person in the room. I hope that at this event, I can find people who think in a new way about entertainment and interactive experiences. I hope to meet people who are also passionate about making an impact through art and creativity. I want to make friends and people I can build with -- together or in parallel!
answers.inspiration:
My mom. She is incredibly hardworking and kind. She is blunt and has strong morals and always gives the best advice. I hope to be like her one day.

My biggest creative inspiration is PinkPantheress. Her creativity and quality of work speaks for itself, and I love her attention to detail in every element of her music. She breaks records, winning the Brit Award for British Producer of the Year as the youngest person and first woman in history. Those are some reasons why I admire her.
